title: App flashes
body: After launching, the app quickly flashes as if it were constantly switching between dark and light modes, and there is nothing that can be done about it. Reinstalling does not help. It is unfortunate, as it looked promising in the screenshots, but the reality is unfortunately different.
author: Senicus

title: Perfect app
body: Routinery is a brilliant app for anyone who wants to get their day on track and stick to good habits. You set up routines like your morning or evening schedule, add tasks, and decide how long each one should take. The app then guides you step by step, making it easy to stay on top of things. It’s simple, clean, and super flexible, though I wish it had an option for tasks without timers—sometimes you just need a checklist, like for taking meds, without the countdown. Still, if you’re looking for structure and flow in your day, this app is a total win!
author: Crockedge
